lines.text: The LORD says the man who maintains justice and keeps the Passover without profaning it is blessed.
He gives eunuchs who choose what pleases Him a name better than silver and gold.
He will bring foreigners who love His name and keep the Sabbath to His holy mountain and make them joyful.

problems.problem: The blessed man is not described as maintaining justice.
The eunuchs are not described as choosing what pleases the LORD.
The foreigners are not described as loving the LORD's name or keeping the Sabbath without profaning it.
